project.name: PureFlow
project.overview: PureFlow is a data analytics platform designed to analyse water consumption in data centres, assess data quality, identify missing values and duplicates, clean and transform datasets, and generate meaningful insights to support sustainable water management.

recommendations.title: Continue unit-aware water monitoring
recommendations.explanation: Keep consumption observations attached to their reporting period, scope, and source unit so changes can be reviewed without combining incompatible quantities.
recommendations.related_metric: Reported water consumption by source unit
recommendations.reason: The loaded records contain consumption in more than one reported unit; preserving unit and period context makes future monitoring interpretable.
recommendations.evidence_level: Directly observed; operational action is advisory
recommendations.limitations: These totals remain separate and are not a normalized time series. This recommendation predicts no water savings.

recommendations.title: Review unusually high reported WUE observations
recommendations.explanation: Verify the highest WUE observations against their source documents, scope, and reporting periods before prioritizing operational follow-up.

flagged_observations.location: Global (as used for Gemini per-prompt water)

recommendations.location: Global portfolio, Global (as used for Gemini per-prompt water), Asia-Pacific (Tokyo), Asia-Pacific (Singapore), Asia-Pacific (Jakarta)
recommendations.reason: Flagging uses the dataset's Tukey upper fence (Q3 plus 1.5 times the interquartile range), an internal screening heuristic rather than an external efficiency benchmark.
recommendations.limitations: Records can represent different scopes, publishers, and years. An outlier is not proof of poor performance, an error, or a comparable peer result.

recommendations.title: Improve location metadata coverage
recommendations.explanation: Where source documentation supports it, add country information to future transformed records and preserve unknown values as unknown.
recommendations.reason: Records with missing country metadata cannot participate in country-level comparisons.
recommendations.limitations: A country should be added only when supported by the source. This recommendation makes no geographic inference.

recommendations.title: Review water-consumption measurement coverage
recommendations.explanation: Identify whether missing consumption measurements reflect a different metric scope or unavailable source reporting, and record that context in future data submissions.
recommendations.related_metric: Rows with an explicitly reported consumption measure
recommendations.reason: Rows without a consumption value cannot contribute to consumption totals or trend analysis.
recommendations.limitations: Not every source row represents a consumption measurement; missing values are not treated as zero.

conclusion: The database contains water-consumption evidence in 2 explicitly reported unit group(s). It also contains 35 WUE observations in L/kWh. These results demonstrate how dataset provenance, cleaning, relational storage, and SQL analysis can support sustainability review. The current evidence supports data-readiness findings and targeted monitoring recommendations, but not a complete sustainability rating or climate/stress comparison. Country metadata is absent on 26 selected observations; improving source coverage and adding linked climate and water-risk assessments would strengthen future analysis.
